name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol
description: Build-only registration shell for the platform typert protocol: src/ holds a vendored snapshot that follows the platform checkout's packages/typert/protocol/src (MIT), compiled into lib/types so the typert generator recognizes the protocol's type-meta symbols. It stays a registered project (the generator maps type-meta symbols by registration); its Context augmentation is removed locally so discovery does not treat the shell as a contributor. The build plane resolves the peer here through tsconfig.base paths, while the test plane and the live profile resolve the published platform package itself.
